column3: NKJV capitalizes “a Rod” and “a Branch” messianically; “shoot” is rendered “Rod,” “rootstock” “stem,” and “will bear fruit” “shall grow.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV capitalizes “Spirit” and “Him.”
Close to the Hebrew; “his delighting” (lit. “smelling”) is rendered “His delight.”
Close to the Hebrew; the terms “hips” and “loins” are rendered “loins” and “waist.”
Close to the Hebrew; “sojourn” is rendered “dwell.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the light-hole of a viper” is rendered “the viper’s den.”
NKJV capitalizes “a Root of Jesse” and “Him”; “nations” is rendered “Gentiles,” and “his resting place will be glory” “shall be glorious.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the Lord” (Adonai) is rendered “the LORD,” and “to acquire” “To recover.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the opposing of Judah” is rendered “the adversaries of Judah.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the stretching out of their hand” is rendered “They shall lay their hand on.”
NKJV renders “divide/devote” as “utterly destroy,” and “with the heat of His wind” as “With His mighty wind.”
